Title: Source 2
Content: A congressional leader received a letter from a citizen urging the leader to take action on civil rights legislation. The following is a response from the congressional leader to the citizen.

:ibox:`text(July 8, 1965)`

Dear Mr. Chagnon:

Thank you for your recent communication concerning the voting rights of Americans. Certainly this is a cherished privilege of `text(every American)` and `text(one)` that must be zealously¹ protected. . . . We in Congress are charged with the responsibility of insuring our citizens the privilege of voting. Please know that I will be restless until this responsibility is fully discharged². . . .

Sincerely yours,

John A. Blatnick, M.C.
